book.name: Malaka
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Malaka byex o

content: Yesu la eivek Yerusalem nambei King
Ka xel la paviy Yerusalem me la tyip Betpage me Betani lek lukendu Oliv nei, Yesu wong e xe xel betiyeing yayuw la,

de neil wou luw, “La wou beyeeng wei di yeip atax wou muw mamim on, de lutika gyeik muw ambeing na eivek, on tyek muw ghe gwei dongi lingheing ti xel tup anghei inyon, dongi lingheing tiyon xelti se ghei dei lek. Muw wa tul yis veil dom na qou me nam inye.
Wangwei xelti teling muw, ‘Muw ghe di wong ambei nyon enva?’ Yond muw a neil wou e, ‘Tambiy Ngandoung embei bong xuk en dom tyek bong enoum daing.’ ”
Luw la me yei dongi lingheing ti toungale myayaing eivek sakwaing mema nayak, me xel tup lek xomek mya om luw tul.
De xomaxoneing valu toungale inyon eno teling, “Inyon muw ghe di wong vati, me ghe di tul dongi lingheing on?”
Luw neil elox ambei kawei Yesu neil wou luw o, me xel xomaxoneing on wong luw qou me la.
Woyom luw qou dongi me la wou Yesu me nex xel xe teimb lek demi, de moxo dei lek.
Xomaxoneing ngenong vax xel xe teimb wei samyekeing o lek sakwaing de xel valu vax xax mema is lis wei xel qateiv eivek xuk yaeing o.
Xel wei la mamunghexeing me xel wei di betiy eno taxe bei,

content.text: Xeilala wei xa yo ena wou tiwei lam eivek Tambiy Ngandoung lei yo! Qapiya Lalo 118:25-26
Xeilala wei xa yo ena lek tete lalei wei xa bumi Dawit wei di lam o!

content: Yesu la eivek Yerusalem me la eivek tete lalei wei xomek vambuing o. Moxo yei e vivekwou lulul sapa, ekom inye embei bouk eivek om la myayaing me lox me la Betani is xel betiyeing xoumeeng yuw.
Yesu tiy xel veil xomek vambuing
Nge yanyeing wei xel di la veil Betani, eno maxepya Yesu.
Om yeila nanghei dingta me yei xax basunghek ti lis, om la en embei gyei bei ewo neing lek. Gyeik la tyip wou eno se yei lulti qe lis venaxow, en inye se bouk wei xax basunghek mi vuk o.
Woyom e neil wou xax, “Xelti tyek se nox me na gya neing lek wang no.” Me e xe xel betiyeing ngo ingwei e neil o.

Ka xel la tyip Yerusalem, Yesu la eivek tete lalei wei xomek vambuing me tiy eti yeiw wei di xouv me wo vateivek nanghei inyon o. Moxo qapyex lelek wei xel wei di pelipek malew wei xel bamba yo me qou malew wei xomek vambuing o me sia wei eti yeiw di wo vateivek lek beliy o,
me peti xel bei xelti se qalei lulul wei vateivek o me qateiv me na nox tete lalei wei xomek vambuing o.
Me ka e di teyoxe wou xel, moxo neil, “Inye xel byex eivek Anutu xe xoulek eno neil ambei nye: Yelemia 7:11

content.text: “‘A xe xomek tyek xel taxe bei
inye xomek wei xel tembuing sapa nam a mi zeimemend eivek o.’

content: Ekom xam ghe wong e wo ‘xomek xupekeing wei xel panaxana yo.’”
Xel lumuki leitata me putoung wei petieing o ngo tine me yimexe sakwaing wei xel embei nyeis e mey yo, xel yaleeng en e, en nambei xel dalus wei qekuma yon etek en e xe teyoxeing.
Gyeik ingwei bouk eivek eno xel lam veil beyeeng ngandoung on me la.
Xax basunghek mupek
Eivek satiboukeing, ka xel di la wou sakwaing, eno xel yei xax basunghek mupek lek luselis me la pundanghou.
Petele wounalei en me neil wou Yesu, “Putoung, wei! Xax basunghek wei wang neil vyam lek eno mupek on!”
Yesu lewexe, “Xam ghe bongis Anutu.
A neil wou xam zonghek, wangwei xelti e neil wou lukendu tine, ‘Qandi me nex xow la eivek mamileeng,’ me e lalei se bo yuw qe e bongis vati wei neil, on tyek bo neing lek ambei kawei e neil o.
Nambei nyon a neil wou xam, vati wei xam ghe zeimemamim en, eno xam ghe bongis bei xam ghe qou woy, me inyon tyek bong ambei xam ghe teling en o.

Me gyeik wa bale en zeimeing mema me wangwei wa laleim embo nilul wou xel nge, ond semaleeng e xe sewokeing veil e, en kandek Mam wei toundei eivek tyoung gheyapu nei eno semaleeng wa xe sewokeing veil.”
Xel teling Yesu en lei wei ngandoung
Xel la tyip Yerusalem no, me ka Yesu di ghavineeng eivek tete lalei wei xomek vambuing o, xel lumuki leitata me putoung wei petieing o me xel teivateiv lam wou e.
Xel teling, “Lulul wei gweimbeeng ne eno wang di wong nangya eti lei me eti wong lei ne wou wang bei wang bong tine?”
Yesu neil elox, “Tyek am bong telinyeing ti wou xam. Xam ghe zewexe lek ay, on tyek a neil wou xam en lei wei andi wong lulti beimambei ne nangya ne.
Xam neil wou ay. Yoan xe lipekeing, inyon lam anghei tyoung gheyapu nei, o lam wou xomaxoneing?”
Xel di luklek inyon wouma eivek xel venaxow senghoing me neil, “Wangwei xey a neimbei, ‘Nanghei tyoung gheyapu,’ on tyek moxo teling, ‘Ekom nambei nya xam seng wongis e?’
Ek wangwei xey a neimbei, ‘Yoan xe lipekeing on lam wou xomaxoneing on inyon se teyei,’” en xel yaleeng en vati wei xomaxoneing tyek bong o, en xel dalus wongis bei Yoan on poropet ti neing ayang.
Om xel lewexe lek Yesu, “Xa loungen.” Yesu neil, “Tyek a se neil teyeimbei eti wong lei ne wou ay me andi wong lulti beimambei ne.”

footnotes.text: -26 Qapiya takwei eno xel tetulexe qayeeng tine valu lek: Ekom wangwei wa se semaleeng xel nge xe sewokeing on tyek mam wei toundei eivek tyoung gheyapu nei eno tyek se semaleeng wa xe sewokeing veil.
